items.title: Nasdaq futures jump 6% as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.take: The board reversed Friday's abrupt resignation of Huang, and Nvidia rocketed as much as 29% premarket after its worst weekly drop since 2008. Analysts are calling it relief, not resolution: the bounce has to survive a few sessions before anyone names a bottom.

items.title: Futures rally after Wall Street's nightmare week
items.take: The S&P 500 and Dow start the week in a correction, and Monday's premarket surge is dragging them back toward the line. Anthropic also stabilized in premarket after its 8.5% slide on Friday, a sign the new AI listings are rejoining the rally.

items.title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $43.9 billion all-stock deal
items.take: Security software's biggest deal of the year landed mid-rebound: 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per Zscaler share. The market liked the target and disliked the price, sending Zscaler up 13% and CrowdStrike down 9.6% on the day.

items.title: US futures rally as AI selloff pauses, Asian authorities support stocks
items.take: Taiwan rose 2.4% with government support behind the tape, and South Korea's finance minister pledged to stabilize a KOSPI that has halved from its peak. The policy put is now visible on both sides of the Pacific.

items.title: What to watch in a short week following market correction
items.take: Wednesday's PCE print is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge and the week's main event, with NY Fed president John Williams speaking today. A holiday-shortened tape cuts both ways: thin volume exaggerates whichever direction wins.
